Name: Mason Jars for Alternative Textures (AT)
Author: errcha
Description:
This is a glass recolour of the preserves jar. It turns the wood into a glass. Purely aesthetic (crafting requirements remain the same).

Now in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] version.

[b]Installation:
[/b]
Need SMAPI and Alternative Textures mod

1. Unzip/Extract
2. Paste the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
